mistakes.title: Missing decoupling capacitor
mistakes.explanation: U1 has a power pin on net '+3.3V', but no bypass/decoupling capacitor connects that net to a recognized ground return. Without local decoupling, supply transients from switching current can couple into the IC and cause glitches, resets, or radiated noise.
mistakes.fix_suggestion: Add a decoupling capacitor (typically 100nF, or per the datasheet) from +3.3V to the nearest ground return, placed within a few mm of U1's power pin.
